observations: CAUSE arXiv v1 (2026-05-19) gives a closed-form Gaussian-state-space index whose bonus increases with volatility and decreases with stochasticity; Appendix C.1 says main bandit baselines and CAUSE use arm-specific known (v_k,s_k) for filtering.
CAUSE Appendix C.4 fixes P0=25, gamma=0.95, K=4, T=200 and 1000 Monte Carlo runs; mixed uses v={1,4}, s={9,25}; s-dominant v=4 with s={9,900}; v-dominant s=25 with v={1,100}.

CAUSE reports rested v=0 regret 22.61±0.88 for s={9,25} and 42.71±2.40 for s={9,900}; it explicitly states 'Code will be released upon publication.' The current preprint status therefore makes missing author CAUSE code an expected limitation, not evidence of code withdrawal.

Fang & Piray, Psychological Review 2026-07-30, introduces PF-HMM for simultaneous volatility/stochasticity inference from binary outcomes and reports human learning rates increasing with true volatility and decreasing with true stochasticity. This is peer-reviewed source-attribution evidence but not yet an AI exploration transfer.

bounded_audit.scope: Independent source-derived simulation, not author code and not an exact reproduction claim. The active-identification audit below intentionally uses the correctly specified Gaussian observation family and a discrete candidate support; it is an optimistic upper-bound test of whether diagnostic sampling can have decision value. It does not inherit the previous run's held-out family-misspecification safety certificate.

cause_formula_reimplementation.formula_notes: Used Eq.29 timing: decision predictive variance Sigma_t=P_{t-1}+v; lambda=m+0.5*Sigma*tilde_alpha, with S/D/alpha* from Eqs.6,23,24 and phi=pi/8. Selected arm gets Kalman update; unselected arm posterior variance advances by v.
cause_formula_reimplementation.interpretation: Both rested checks are within combined Monte-Carlo uncertainty of the published CAUSE means, providing a timing/formula sanity check before source-unknown extensions. Main restless values are recorded only as local controls because Figure 1 exact numerical bar labels were not source-recovered.

active_identification_v_dominant.environment: Paper-scale v-dominant support: four arms, s=25, two v=1 and two v=100, T=200, gamma=0.95, P0=25. Only selected arm observed.
active_identification_v_dominant.source_inference: Per-arm exact discrete Gaussian mixture over v in {1,100}, with hypothesis-specific Kalman states. Semantic-confidence gate required posterior semantic mass >=0.995 after >=4 observations; otherwise a fixed shared/base CAUSE tracker used v=10,s=25.
active_identification_v_dominant.diagnostic_rule: For nonconfident arms, estimated one-step hypothesis information gain by 5-node Gauss-Hermite quadrature, multiplied by posterior CAUSE-index dispersion plus 0.25, and subtracted immediate current-index opportunity cost. Diagnostic scale selected from {0.5,1,2,4,8,16} on 80 disjoint calibration seeds; scale=1 had the lowest calibration regret.
active_identification_v_dominant.interpretation: In the correctly specified Gaussian v-dominant regime, a few diagnostic pulls make the conservative hard gate significantly better than the fixed shared/base control and its confident semantic-error upper bound is below 0.1%. However posterior family/source averaging is substantially better than active hard diagnosis, by 33.70 regret points (95% bootstrap 22.10 to 46.49). Thus the value signal is real in this optimistic regime, but the stronger design lesson is to preserve uncertainty through BMA rather than force diagnosis. This does not clear the prior run's required robustness gate because t/skew/correlated/mixture misspecification was not integrated into this active controller.

mechanistic_update.positive: Cause-specific information acquisition can have measurable decision value when source hypotheses are correct and source asymmetry is large; the active diagnostic policy beat the fixed shared control in the paper-scale v-dominant support.
mechanistic_update.stronger_positive: Soft posterior averaging over source hypotheses outperformed both hard MAP and confidence-gated active diagnosis in the same well-specified condition, indicating that source attribution is most useful as graded action-value uncertainty rather than as a semantic label whenever the family is trusted.
mechanistic_update.negative_boundary: The paper's main CAUSE regret experiments assume known arm-specific v,s. Therefore active identification of v versus s is an extension beyond its demonstrated main-experiment scope. The robust family-misspecification certificate from the preceding run cannot be transferred to the single-Gaussian active controller.
mechanistic_update.integration_gate: Do not connect to dormant-memory tracking yet. Need active/BMA decision value and <=0.1% confident semantic reversal simultaneously under held-out observation-family misspecification.

deferred_new_lead.evidence: PF-HMM normatively dissociates volatility and stochasticity from binary outcomes; human reversal-learning data show opposite learning-rate effects, and the sea-lion task model selection reported PF-HMM frequency 0.757 with protected exceedance probability 1.00.
deferred_new_lead.next_transfer_question: Whether explicit discrete source inference improves binary-bandit or nonstationary classification decisions versus source-agnostic uncertainty adaptation under matched compute/sample budgets.

limits: Active audit used known Gaussian observation-family class and discrete true support; it is optimistic.
Shared/base v=10,s=25 is a fixed source-agnostic control, not an optimized generic policy.
No author CAUSE implementation was available; preprint says code will be released upon publication.
No genuine PAST/GROUSE/SPLiT execution in this run.

exact_next_action: Port the diagnostic-value acquisition term into the existing family-marginal semantic-invariance controller rather than the single-Gaussian-family audit used here. Keep source-specific action only when plausible observation families agree on semantic ordering; within that safe set use posterior/Bayesian model averaging rather than hard MAP when possible. Calibrate on disjoint Gaussian/t5/moderate-skew/AR families and test held-out t3, stronger skew, correlated burst, scale drift and mixtures under action-dependent partial observation. Require both (a) exact/Wilson 95% upper bound on confident semantic reversal <=0.1% under held-out misspecification and (b) statistically resolved discounted-regret improvement over always-shared/base in a predeclared mixed or v-dominant regime. Also continue read-only author-code search; CAUSE v1 explicitly says code will be released upon publication, so do not treat current absence as a reproducibility failure. If robust active acquisition fails the value gate, retain the safety boundary and pivot to the peer-reviewed PF-HMM binary-source-inference mechanism, testing whether its discrete source attribution yields an AI transfer beyond source-agnostic binary-bandit baselines before any dormant-memory integration.
